title: Finance Procurement Administrator ( Part-Time)
description:
Who we are

GlobalData operates an intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.

By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organisations see what s coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.

Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organisations across the world s largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Why join GlobalData?

GlobalData is at a pivotal point in its growth journey, and we need curious, ambitious, courageous people to support us in achieving our vision to deliver intelligence that transforms uncertainty into opportunity for the world s most successful organisations.?

Our big ambitions mean that life at GlobalData is fast-paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding. Working together in an intellectually challenging environment, where learning is super-charged to keep us on our toes, the highly stimulating, fast-paced, global environment we operate in, and our bold ambitions result in unique learning opportunities for our people.

The role

We now have an opening for a part- time role(15 hours a week) Procurement Administrator based in Hull. Working within the finance team, we expect you to have close interaction with the wider commercial business, with the main responsibility being processing supplier s invoices and matching to PO s.

Now is an incredibly exciting time to join and be part of a business that is fast-paced, vibrant and ambitious, with opportunities for everyone to develop and succeed.

What you ll be doing
- Matching up incoming supplier invoices to purchase orders in the procurement tracker.
- Submit invoices with 3 way match (PO, Goods Receipt, Invoice) for processing.
- Preparation of payment schedules to deadline.
- Communicate with suppliers to enforce No Po, No Pay policy.
- Query resolution.
- Supplier Statement reconciliations.

What we re looking for
- Technical skills - Knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Dedicated and accountable - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail and effectively managing expectations.
- Organised - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail as well as managing expectations effectively.
- A strong communicator - able to communicate well and build strong, collaborative relationships across the business.
- Adaptable and positive mindset - a confident personality with a positive attitude towards change and new challenges.

In addition to a rewarding career, we support our GlobalData colleagues with a range of benefits across health, finances, fitness, travel, tech and more. To find out more about the roles and benefits on offer in your region, visit (url removed)

GlobalData believes strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

description:
Job Title: Customer Service Assistant
Contract Type: Permanent
Salary: £26,251.43 per annum (pro rata)
Working Hours: 23.3 hours per week
Working Pattern: Working a 3-week rolling rota of 5.5hr shifts, incl weekends 9-5 and bank hols.
Location: Cecil Gardens, Hull

If you share our values and are excited about making a significant impact at Riverside, please ensure you attach a current CV and covering letter. At Riverside we recruit to potential not just on skills and experience, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the essential criteria on the job description.
Please note that whilst we will accept applications on the basis of any form of valid legal permission to work in the UK, we will be surrendering the Riverside Sponsorship licence, so for the avoidance of doubt, we are unable to apply for any further sponsorships whether on behalf of existing colleagues or candidates.

The difference you will make as a Customer Service Assistant
You will be responsible for providing a professional, customer-focused reception service within one of Riverside's extra care facilities, handling all enquiries and welcoming customers and visitors in a busy, modern housing environment.

About you
We are looking for someone with:
- Experience of working within a housing or support environment
- Good communication and conflict resolution skills
- Organisational skills
- Experience working with vulnerable customers

Why Riverside?
At Riverside, we're a housing association with a difference - enhancing the everyday for all our customers. For 90 years, we've been revitalising neighbourhoods and supporting communities by providing the homes they need to live full, fulfilling and rewarding lives.

We have a portfolio of over 75,000 affordable residential and retirement homes across the UK. Our work ranges from homelessness services to social care, employment support to retirement living, and we need the best people on board to help us.
Working with us, you'll enjoy:
- Competitive pay & generous pension
- 25 days holidays plus bank holidays (pro rata)
- Investment in your learning, personal development and technology
- A wide range of benefits

We are inclusive. At Riverside, we value diversity in all its forms. We foster a workplace where all individuals are respected, empowered, and heard. Our commitment to inclusivity drives our success and enriches the lives of our customers and colleagues.

title: Facilities Coordinator - 12 Month FTC - Hull
description:
Facilities Coordinator - 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract Location: Hull, East Yorkshire
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Full Time 12 Month FTC
Hours: 35 hours per week
Working Pattern: Hybrid / Agile Working
Travel: Regular travel to UK offices, with occasional overnight stays

An excellent opportunity has arisen for a proactive and organised Facilities Coordinator to join the Facilities team of a well-established and forward-thinking legal services organisation based in Hull.

This is a varied and hands-on position, supporting the day-to-day management, maintenance and smooth running of multiple office locations across the UK.

Working closely with colleagues, landlords, contractors and external suppliers, you will help ensure that offices remain safe, compliant, well-maintained and efficient, while supporting facilities projects, office moves and workplace improvements.

Offering hybrid working, an excellent benefits package and exposure to multi-site facilities management, this opportunity would suit someone who enjoys a varied role combining practical problem-solving, facilities administration and health and safety responsibilities.

The Role As Facilities Coordinator, your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating day-to-day facilities operations, building maintenance and repairs across multiple UK offices.
- Liaising with landlords, maintenance contractors, suppliers and third-party service providers.
- Supporting workplace health and safety compliance, including risk assessments and workstation assessments.
- Monitoring outstanding actions and ensuring facilities and safety issues are addressed promptly.
- Assisting with office moves, refurbishments, minor maintenance works and facilities improvement projects.
- Maintaining accurate facilities records, compliance documentation and building safety information.
- Supporting the review and development of facilities policies, procedures and processes.
- Managing facilities-related requests and tickets through Salesforce.
- Coordinating and booking complex business travel arrangements.
- Supporting internal and external events and ensuring offices operate effectively.

About You We are looking for a practical, organised and approachable individual who enjoys taking ownership of tasks and ensuring things run smoothly.

Essential requirements:
- Previous experience or a good working knowledge of office health and safety procedures.
- IOSH qualification or currently working towards one.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build relationships with colleagues, contractors and suppliers.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- A proactive, flexible and hands-on approach to problem-solving.
- Ability to work independently and make sound decisions.
- Full UK driving licence and access to a car.
- Willingness to travel regularly between UK offices, including occasional overnight stays.

Desirable experience:
- Previous experience in Facilities Coordination, Facilities Management or Office Management.
- Knowledge of Health and Safety Executive (HSE) guidance.
- First Aid at Work qualification.
- Fire Marshal training or certification.
- Experience supporting multi-site office operations.

Previous experience within a law firm or legal services organisation is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- 12-month fixed-term contract.
- Hybrid and agile working arrangements.
- 35-hour working week.
- Private pension.
- Medical insurance.
- Generous annual leave allowance.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to gain experience supporting facilities operations across multiple UK locations.

Interested? If you're an experienced Facilities Coordinator, Facilities Assistant, Office Coordinator or Office Manager with a strong understanding of workplace health and safety, I'd be keen to hear from you.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a progressive organisation offering flexibility, variety and a supportive working environment.

title: Temporary Bookkeeper
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and adaptable Bookkeeper looking for a hands-on role within a small business? Are you used to a stand alone position where you can support the finance function and look at ways to make efficiencies? Are you immediately available and able to work in a temporary contract for a well established business who need additional support to process a backlog of work in the first instance.

Our client, a well-established and growing manufacturer based in the Bridlington area, is seeking a temporary Bookkeeper to join their team and support them with a backlog of accounts work.

They are looking for an enthusiastic individual to take on a crucial role, providing essential financial support and contributing to the smooth operation of the business.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with solid bookkeeping experience, particularly with Sage, who is eager to become an integral part of a hands-on SME.

What the Bookkeeper job involves

You ll play a key role in managing the daily financial operations, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
- Raising customer invoices and delivery notes on a daily basis.
- Managing the invoice factoring process.
- Daily monitoring of bank accounts and cashflow.
- Payroll administration, collating employee hours each week from a clocking in system and send to payroll.
- Matching invoices and accurately allocating payments within Sage.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who enjoys being at the heart of an operational team, managing multiple financial priorities, and providing excellent administrative support.

Skills required

We re looking for candidates who can demonstrate a practical approach and a willingness to contribute beyond traditional bookkeeping duties. Ideal candidates will have:
- Proven experience with Sage 50 would be beneficial.
- The ability to manage and allocate payments efficiently within Sage.
- Self managed and able to work on their own initiative.
- A high degree of adaptability and flexibility to take on a range of tasks as needed.
- Previous experience in bookkeeping from a small / medium size business.

This role would suit someone who is not afraid to contribute to a busy, hands-on environment.

Other information
- Working hours are initially 10 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Friday.
- On-site car parking available.
- Own transport is essential due to the location.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive if you have not heard from us within 2 weeks, please assume you have not been short listed for this particular role.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
An established and successful firm of Chartered Accountants is looking to strengthen its Payroll Bureau team in their Goole office.

It's a full time, Monday to Friday role, dealing with:
- Processing payrolls, gross to net
- Processing HMRC submissions
- Calculation of statutory payments
- Liaising directly with clients
- Resolving queries and general support
- Working towards tight deadlines
- Sending BACS transmissions
- Preparation of P45s and P60s

The successful applicant will need a minimum of a year's previous experience in Payroll (ideally bureau) and knowledge of associated tasks, have an understanding of Auto Enrolment with good numeracy and a team player.

On offer is a competitive salary, contributory Pension and life insurance scheme, flexible working including Flexitime system, annual leave of 25 days, plus bank holidays (full time equivalent), convenient office location with easily accessible free car parking, Employee Assistance Programme, friendly working environment

title: Accounts Receivable Administrator
description:
Role: Accounts Receivable Administrator

Location: Hessle, HU13

Are you a proactive and driven Accounts Receivable Administrator with great communication skills? Can you manage and support company credit control by taking responsibility for your own book of debtor accounts?

Then Scientific Laboratory Supplies (SLS) is the right fit for you. Join us and contribute to our mission of being the UK's largest independent supplier of laboratory equipment, chemicals, and consumables.

We have an exciting opportunity available for a Credit Controller to join our finance team based in Hessle, HU13, on a full-time, permanent basis.

Job Summary:

The Accounts Receivable Administrator will join the SLS Finance team and contribute to all areas within the finance function. The successful candidate will be asked to support the busy credit control function in the office but must be willing to provide support as needed to other areas of the finance function which will include communicating with colleagues, external parties, customers, and vendors.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take a proactive role in managing and supporting company credit control by taking responsibility for own book of debtor accounts.
- Use all forms of communication (email, letters, and telephone) to professionally contact debtors and ensure payment of outstanding invoices.
- Support the ongoing process of credit checking new customers and open new credit accounts ensuring the company has all the relevant information.
- Support and resolve all problems experienced in the credit control function including providing copy invoices, obtaining proof of delivery.
- Work closely with colleagues in Sales and Customer Services to resolve any customer queries and enquiries to progress matters to a satisfactory conclusion.
- Report regularly to the Accounts Office Manager on outstanding issues and promptly inform them of potential debtors' problems.
- When required, help colleagues to manage the "slsledger" email inbox, resolving enquiries quickly and effectively and to pass enquiries onto colleagues in both Finance and other departments for resolution.
- Maintain financial system records and enter data accurately.

Perform general clerical duties when required, including, but not limited to, typing, mailing, filing correspondence and answering telephone calls.

Ideal Candidate:
- Prior experience of working in a credit control / accounts receivable function.
- Comfortable with IT.
- Strong literacy and numeracy skills.
- Interpersonal skills, appreciation of good internal and external customer service behaviour.
- Be organised, methodical, self-motivated, and driven.
- Responsive and re-active.
- Good customer-facing and personal relationship skills.
- Be able to communicate at all levels.
- Ability to work within a flexible team.

About us:

SLS are the UK's largest independent supplier of laboratory equipment, chemicals, and consumables. Because of our independence, we have a unique approach to sourcing and supplying the highest quality, best value products, and brands. Supplying to a wide range of sectors, provides a diverse and interesting customer base as well as providing countless opportunity to grow and expand.

With customers all over the UK, we are a stable and growing company who have an excellent reputation in the market.

We are passionate about our people and have developed a strong team dynamic who are welcoming and supportive of new individuals, joining the company with a brilliant management team to support you as you find your feet in the role.

We are also proud to be a Living Wage Employer and committed to equal opportunities and actively promote a diverse and inclusive working environment, and fairness for everyone.

Alongside our commitment to your professional and personal development, we also offer a generous benefits package including:
- Competitive salary
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Company pension
- Enhanced Maternity and Paternity leave
- Small, friendly, and sociable teams with staff events
- Company profit bonus schemes
- Cycle 2work schemes
- Career opportunities for development and progression

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant
Location: Hessle
Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 pro rata
Hours: Part-time

Consortium Professional Recruitment are working on a retained basis with a well-established UK services business to recruit a Finance Assistant. Based in Hessle, this varied, part-time role offers the opportunity to join a supportive team, take ownership of day-to-day finance activities and contribute to improving processes and reporting.

The Opportunity

As a Finance Assistant, you'll play a key role in:
- Managing invoicing, payments and resolving discrepancies.
- Maintaining accurate financial records using Sage, including processing debits, credits and bank reconciliations.
- Updating client databases, ensuring pricing changes and information are recorded accurately.
- Preparing weekly and monthly reports covering sales performance, financial results, budgets and key business information.
- Supporting the team with financial queries and identifying opportunities to improve processes, including the use of AI technology.

About You

We're looking for someone who can bring:
- Previous experience in finance administration, accounts support or a similar role.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good Excel skills and confidence using financial systems, ideally Sage.
- Excellent organisation, initiative and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- A friendly, positive personality and the ability to work well within a small team.

You'll also be comfortable with technology and open to learning new ways of working. Previous AI experience isn't needed, just curiosity and a willingness to embrace new ideas.

The Benefits
- Salary of £28,000 to £32,000 pro rata.
- Part-time working hours.
- A welcoming, supportive and close-knit team.
- A varied role with responsibility and the freedom to use your initiative.
- The opportunity to contribute ideas, improve processes and develop your skills.

How to Apply

An opportunity has arisen for a full-time Band 2 Administration Assistant to work within our Mental Health Crisis Team based at Miranda House in Hull. You will be expected to be flexible and work in a fast paced and highly demanding environment within the main office as well as providing cover to a very busy reception area. The administration team provides 24 hour, 7 day a week cover which is worked on a rota basis incorporating enhanced pay for unsocial hours. This provides a refreshing work life balance. This role involves liaising with health care professionals from the Trust and outside agencies, also dealing with queries from patients requiring a service. Excellent interpersonal skills and being able to work on own initiative are both essential. The successful candidate will have good keyboard skills enabling them to assist in creating, developing and maintaining new processes and procedures. This includes regular data inputting using patient systems (Systm One ) in accordance with the Trust standards. Along with all other Microsoft Packages. Applicants will have RSA III and OCRIII/ECDL or equivalent NVQ Qualification, a good standard of Maths and English and have previous experience of carrying out general administrative procedures in an office environment. Experience of using software packages including Microsoft Word/Outlook and Excel are beneficial. Experience with the Trust Patient Information Systems (Systm One ) would be advantageous.
